question: In ‘Andes Mountain’ of South America animal which is used for transportation is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**L**____lamas__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the Andes mountains of South America, **llamas are used for transportation. **
 
• **Llamas **live high up in the Andes mountains of South America.
 
• Because, **Llamas are well-suited to these conditions**, **with hooves that give a good grip to climb steep mountain paths** and **thick fur to keep them warm.**
 
• Therefore, **L**lamas are used for transportation.
